title: Bank Account with guarded money
prompt: Inside `Solution`, write `static class Account` with a `private final String owner`, `private double balance`, constructor `Account(String owner, double startingBalance)` (negative start → IllegalArgumentException), `public void deposit(double)` (must be positive, else IAE), `public void withdraw(double)` (must be positive AND not exceed balance, else IAE), and `public double getBalance()`.

tests.name: happy path
tests.hint: Deposit adds, withdraw subtracts, getter reports.

tests.name: rules are enforced
tests.hint: All three violations must throw IllegalArgumentException.
